name: Xona XC-SF150-X4 in Ramona Chip Holder 16 well
author: Ramona Optics
part_number: XC-SF150-X4 in Ramona Xona X4 chip holder, 4 slide, 27mm pitch
notes: The sixteen wells of this definition are the sixteen imaging regions of four Xona XC-SF150-X4 chips loaded in the Ramona 4-pocket, 27mm-pitch holder (Ramona_Xona_chip_holder_4_well_plate): four culture units (A-D) on each of four chips, each well covering one unit's microgroove barrier between its two compartment channels. It is the file to select when four chips are loaded in that holder, and is the 27mm-pitch counterpart of Xona_XC-SF150-X4_in_Ramona_chip_holder_12_well_plate; everything about the chip and the imaging region (size 4.00 x 1.00mm, 80 um depth, 150 um COC film, and how each was sourced or scaled) is as recorded in that file and in Xona_XC-SF150-X4_4_well_plate. Requested 2026-11-17, issue #66. GRID: 4 rows x 4 columns. The chips lie with their 75.50mm axis along the plate's width, so the units step in y (rows, row_pitch 12.00mm, Xona's printed unit pitch) and the chips step in x (columns, column_pitch 27.00mm, the holder's pocket pitch printed on its drawing, and intended per the requester). 'pitch' carries the smaller, 12.00mm, as the schema suggests; a reader that knows only 'pitch' places the columns 12.00mm apart and so places this plate wrong. Columns at the pocket centres x = 23.38, 50.38, 77.38 and 104.38mm; rows at y = 24.74, 36.74, 48.74 and 60.74mm (42.74 -/+ 6.00 and 18.00), the centres of the holder's imaging windows. A1 is the unit-A barrier of the left-hand chip. The wells span x 21.38-106.38mm and y 24.24-61.24mm, inside the pockets. THE HOLDER, from Ramona's dimension drawing 'Xona Chip Holders - 3x and 4x Dimensions' and STL 'Xona_Holder_4x27mm.stl' of 2026-11-17 (internal, on file at Ramona; see Ramona_Xona_chip_holder_4_well_plate's notes, including its 2026-11-17 CORRECTION: the holder was rebuilt from that newer set at the requester's request and no value changed): footprint 127.76 x 85.48mm, skirt 6.00mm high, body inset 1.60mm to an 8.00mm top with one 4.50mm chamfer at the A1 corner (A1 at the chamfered top-left corner, as the drawing marks it), pockets 25.80 x 75.80mm with 0.30mm clearance round the chip, floor ledge at z = 1.50mm. From the CAD, the chip's film rests on the pocket floor ledge 1.50mm above the resting plane, so the film's underside is at 1.50mm and the sample sits at 1.65mm (1.50mm + the 150 um film). Those are NOT written as bottom_elevation and floor_height: with 'depth' the chip's 80 um channel height and 'height' the holder's 8.00mm top, readers that take a well's top at the plate's top would place the floor at 7.92mm, and the two would contradict each other. Recording them waits on a decision about which height a chips-loaded definition should carry. 'height' 8.00mm is the holder's top face; the chip's overall thickness is not published, so whether its reservoir bosses stand above 8.00mm is not known. The 27mm pitch is not a multiple of the MCAM's 18mm micro-camera pitch, so the four chips do not sit at the same position under a camera column, unlike the 36mm holder.
